intro: Thursday brings a Firefox security fix, tools for maintaining AI agents and restored Millennium Line service. Canada’s services surplus narrows, while advance city picks include piano and oud, acoustic guitar, creative AI and a Scotch dinner.

stories.title: Firefox fixes a high-impact layout vulnerability
stories.summary: Mozilla released Firefox 159.0.1 to correct boundary conditions in its block-and-inline layout component. The November 3 advisory rates the vulnerability high impact; users should install the fixed version through Firefox’s update controls.

stories.title: Dependabot starts updating agent packages
stories.summary: Dependabot now opens version-update pull requests for supported Git dependencies in Agent Package Manager manifests, regenerating existing lockfiles. Add an apm entry and schedule to dependabot.yml; the feature maintains versions but does not provide security updates.

stories.title: Palette separates slide planning from drawing
stories.summary: IBM Research detailed Palette, a fine-tuned 20-billion-parameter model that plans presentations before generating each slide’s code. Synthetic training data and a checking system offer techniques for developers adapting smaller models to an organization’s design language.

stories.title: One model, three agents, widely different results
stories.summary: IBM compared CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents on 90 AppWorld tasks using the same open-weight model, reporting completion rates from 30% to 81%. The experiment highlights architecture’s influence on performance; its limited workload does not establish a universal winner.

stories.title: Millennium Line service returns after Gilmore fire
stories.summary: SkyTrain service resumed shortly after 11 a.m. Wednesday following a fire beneath Gilmore Station that closed three Millennium Line stations. Firefighters found a burning bench surrounding a support pillar and observed concrete damage; a bus bridge carried diverted passengers.

stories.title: Bear-attack investigation continues near Bella Coola
stories.summary: Conservation officers are investigating whether multiple grizzlies were involved in an attack that relatives say killed a mother and daughter. People should continue avoiding the west trail area of the Snootka trail system while capture efforts continue.

stories.title: Canada’s services surplus narrows
stories.summary: Canada’s services imports increased 1.5% in September, outpacing the 0.9% rise in exports, Statistics Canada reported Wednesday. The monthly services surplus narrowed to $0.3 billion from $0.5 billion in August, despite exports reaching $21.4 billion.

events.date: 2026-11-20 · 8 p.m. · Mel Lehan Hall at St. James, 3214 West 10th Avenue, Vancouver
events.title: Migrantes connects piano, oud and migration
events.description: Mauro Sigura and Andrea Manzoni blend jazz, classical and Arab-Ottoman influences in a musical journey through dreams, hope and travel. Doors open at seven for the all-ages concert; advance hall tickets are $30, with a separate streaming option.

events.date: 2026-11-29 · 8 p.m. · Mel Lehan Hall at St. James, 3214 West 10th Avenue, Vancouver
events.title: Don Ross and Julie Malía share an acoustic bill
events.description: Canadian guitarist Don Ross and Dresden-based singer-guitarist Julie Malía bring their touring partnership to Kitsilano. Their repertoires span original songs, interpretations and fingerstyle guitar; advance hall admission is $35 for the eight o’clock performance.

meetups.date: 2026-12-09 · 6 p.m. onward · The Pint Public House, 455 Abbott Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: Vancouver tech communities gather for year-end
meetups.description: Cloud Events invites developers, architects, students and community organizers to its annual social at The Pint. Half the pub is reserved for conversation, music and giveaways; registration is open for an evening connecting people across local technology groups.

meetups.date: 2026-12-10 · Doors 6:30 p.m. · Multimodal Media Lab, 375 Water Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: AI Film Club shares work and production tools
meetups.description: Kevin Friel hosts filmmakers, editors, VFX artists and creative technologists for screenings and practical AI workflow demonstrations. Bring a laptop to show a project; community tickets are $20, while free member registration requires BC + AI membership verification.

dining.date: 2026-11-26 · Fairmont Hotel Vancouver, 900 West Georgia Street, Vancouver
dining.title: Glenmorangie closes an autumn Scotch dinner series
dining.description: Brand ambassador Bryan Simpson hosts an evening exploring Glenmorangie’s maturation and cask experiments alongside a bespoke dinner. The hotel’s series page links to booking; individual whisky expressions and the detailed menu remain unannounced.
